# Ludovico Papalia

> PhD Candidate in Legal Informatics at the University of Bologna (Cycle 39). Researcher at the intersection of blockchain technology, distributed ledger systems, and legislative simplification. Lawyer by training, developer by choice. Co-tutela with Vrije Universiteit Brussel. Industry collaboration with the IOTA Foundation within the PRIN2022/ERC HyperModeLex project.

## Research

Ludovico Papalia's doctoral research investigates how distributed ledger technologies — specifically the IOTA Tangle — can be applied to track the lifecycle of legislative norms, detect regulatory overlaps and contradictions, and reduce the complexity of national legislative corpora. The system integrates Akoma Ntoso-encoded legal documents with on-chain provenance records.

**Core research question**: Can blockchain-based systems provide a scalable, tamper-evident infrastructure for legislative simplification and parliamentary process tracking?

**Keywords**: blockchain, DLT, IOTA Tangle, legislative simplification, Akoma Ntoso, FRBR, smart contracts, digital government, parliamentary informatics, legal XML, normative complexity, regulatory transparency

**Related areas**: private international law and smart contracts, Digital Euro / CBDC regulation, AI in the justice system, right to be forgotten, digital evidence, online hate speech.

## Divulgative Content (Italian)

Ludovico Papalia produces legal explainer content in Italian aimed at a general audience, under the series "A Tu per Tu con l'Esperto di Diritto Informatico". Each article is paired with a video interview and covers practical IT law topics.

- [Articoli di divulgazione giuridica — indice](https://www.ludovicopapalia.com/divulgativi-index.html): Hub page listing all Italian-language legal explainer articles by Ludovico Papalia.
- [Hai la 2FA attiva: sei ancora vulnerabile](https://www.ludovicopapalia.com/art-divulgativi/autenticazione-due-fattori-punto-debole.html): Guida ai sistemi di autenticazione a due fattori, password manager e sicurezza digitale. Ludovico Papalia esperto di cybersicurezza spiega la gerarchia 2FA e perché l'utente rimane il punto debole.
- [SIM Swap: il tuo numero di telefono non è una prova d'identità](https://www.ludovicopapalia.com/art-divulgativi/sim-swap-il-numero-non-e-identita.html): Analisi della truffa del cambio SIM, dati italiani e internazionali, quadro normativo AGCOM e misure di protezione. Ludovico Papalia esperto di SIM swap e truffe digitali.
- [SIAE contro Meta: chi ha perso davvero?](https://www.ludovicopapalia.com/art-divulgativi/siae-contro-meta.html): Analysis of the SIAE vs Meta dispute over Italian music licensing on Instagram and Facebook. Ludovico Papalia esperto di diritto d'autore digitale e creator economy.
